evidence.text:
Reason for referral: Evaluation of breathlessness on exertion with progressively reduced
exercise tolerance.

Findings: Sinus bradycardia at 53 bpm. Normal axis. PR interval 149 ms, QRS 82 ms, QTc 403
ms.
Impression: Sinus bradycardia, otherwise normal tracing.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
55%. Mild mitral regurgitation. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Normal left ventricular systolic function.

BASIC METABOLIC PANEL
Sodium: 134 mmol/L (L)
Potassium: 5.0 mmol/L
Chloride: 99 mmol/L
CO2: 24 mmol/L
BUN: 8 mg/dL
Creatinine: 0.6 mg/dL
Glucose: 125 mg/dL (H)
Calcium: 10.0 mg/dL

Metoprolol succinate 50 mg by mouth once daily
Lisinopril 10 mg by mouth once daily
Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily
Warfarin 5 mg by mouth once daily

EXAM:
General: well appearing, no distress.
Neck:no carotid bruits.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, no murmurs or gallops.
Lungs: faint bibasilar crackles.
Extremities: 1+ pitting edema of both ankles.
